summary: Verified iteration 10 fix for GET /api/collections/summary user-scoping. The previously failing test TestCascadeAndDelete::test_summary_scope_non_admin (non-admin emp3 should see totals=0 because scope is filtered to their own username) now PASSES. Ran targeted test + full test_iteration10_collections.py suite (20/21 passed). Verified backend code at server.py:1433-1435 correctly applies q['user'] = u['username'] when role != admin.

minor.issue: TestCascadeAndDelete::test_rename_collector_cascades is flaky under parallel xdist scheduling due to cross-worker state pollution around the emp7->emp7test rename/delete/recreate sequence. Passes standalone. Not related to summary scoping fix. Consider marking with @pytest.mark.serial or moving to a dedicated worker.

action_items: Fix confirmed working; no action required for the reported bug.
(Optional) Harden test_rename_collector_cascades against parallel execution to eliminate pre-existing flakiness.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1426-1455 collections_summary correctly scopes non-admin users via q['user'] = u['username']; admin sees workspace-wide totals. Aggregation logic and date filling are correct.
seed_data_creation: None. Test-created entries prefixed TEST_ cleaned up by module fixture. emp7 user state restored post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The user-scoping fix in GET /api/collections/summary is verified. Test test_summary_scope_non_admin passes both in parallel and standalone. The one failing test (test_rename_collector_cascades) is a pre-existing flakiness in parallel xdist mode unrelated to this fix.
rca_of_issue: Root cause of the original bug: /api/collections/summary was not filtering the aggregation query by user for non-admin roles, so employees saw workspace-wide totals. Fix at backend/server.py:1434-1435 adds `if u['role'] != 'admin': q['user'] = u['username']` — this mirrors the scoping applied on GET /api/collections list endpoint. Verified: emp3 (non-collector, no entries) now sees totals.total == 0 while admin sees all entries.
